items.name: 桌上電話
items.closeup_subject: a beige push-button desk telephone with coiled cord, handset resting on the cradle, unlabelled keys, a cracked corner of the casing, yellowed plastic
items.player_sees: 拿起話筒：線路無聲（停電）；話筒下的托架周圍有一圈沒積灰的乾淨印子，代表最近常被使用。

move.movable_part: the telephone handset with a short length of coiled cord
move.revealed: the empty cradle with its two hook switches pressed up, a clean dust-free outline of the handset on the casing, a few dust specks around it

items.name: 銀行燈
items.closeup_subject: a brass banker's desk lamp with a dark wine-red glass shade, brass pull chain, round brass base with a small blank brass plate, a dent on the base rim
items.player_sees: 拉鏈開關可拉動；停電時不亮，P01 解開後亮。底座有撞凹痕和空白銘牌（純氛圍）。

items.name: 閱覽室窗戶
items.closeup_subject: a large steel-framed window of rain-streaked glass at night, blurred distant city lights and a red glow, condensation, one smeared hand-wiped patch on the inside of the glass
items.player_sees: 雨夜城景；玻璃內側有一塊被手抹開的霧痕（誤導：可能只是白天有人擦過）。

items.name: 書架檔案箱
items.closeup_subject: a lidded cardboard archive box on a grey steel shelf, worn corners, a blank paper label holder
items.player_sees: 把箱子滑出：架上露出一塊沒積灰的長方形和幾根散落的釘書針，箱子後面只有牆。

move.movable_part: the lidded cardboard archive box alone
move.revealed: the bare grey steel shelf after the box has been slid out: a clean rectangle in the thick dust where the box stood and a few loose staples, the back wall behind

items.name: 閱覽室雙開門
items.closeup_subject: a pair of dark wooden double doors with wired frosted glass panels, scuffed brass push plates, and a wall-mounted card reader with a red LED beside them
items.player_sees: 磨砂玻璃後一片黑；門把附近有新刮痕（誤導：舊館日常磨損）。讀卡器紅燈。

items.name: 走廊牆鐘
items.closeup_subject: a round institutional wall clock with a cream face, only tick marks and no numerals, dark red-brown rim, hands at 9:07, a fine hairline crack across the glass
items.player_sees: 時鐘走著，9:07（標準時）。玻璃有一道細裂紋，鐘框上有積灰（只是氛圍）。
items.art_status: USE N01-BG_DETAIL-008 (existing close-up; text conflict: clock is stopped)

items.name: 終端旁檯燈
items.closeup_subject: a dark metal articulated desk lamp with a dome shade, warm bulb glowing, round heavy base
items.player_sees: 可以轉動燈頭照向終端或時鐘（純操作手感）。

items.name: 桌上收納盒
items.closeup_subject: a small lidded metal-and-card storage box on the desk next to a stack of hardback ledgers
items.player_sees: 掀開蓋子：裡面是空白的磁碟片和一卷印表機色帶——跟終端有關的耗材，不是線索。

move.movable_part: the lid of the small storage box
move.revealed: the open storage box seen from the front and slightly above: a row of blank black floppy disks in paper sleeves and a spare printer ribbon cartridge, all unlabelled

items.name: 檔案推車
items.closeup_subject: a chrome wire library book trolley on castors with two cardboard boxes on its shelves, standing on a wet terrazzo floor
items.player_sees: 推開推車：地上有新的輪痕穿過水漬（誤導：可能只是保安巡邏時推過）。

move.movable_part: the chrome wire trolley with its two boxes, seen from the front
move.revealed: the wet terrazzo floor where the trolley stood: four small dry circles where the castors were and a curving track of wheel marks through the water film

items.name: 終端桌抽屜
items.closeup_subject: the stack of three small steel drawers of the terminal desk, worn grey paint, small handles
items.player_sees: 拉開最上層抽屜：舊鉛筆、橡皮擦、斷掉的尺、幾張空白便條。

move.movable_part: the top steel drawer front alone
move.revealed: the top drawer pulled open, seen from the front and slightly above: old pencils, an eraser, a snapped wooden ruler and a few blank memo slips

items.name: 微縮膠片閱讀機
items.closeup_subject: a beige-grey vintage microfilm reader with a large dark hooded screen, two film reel spindles, a lit lamp window and knobs
items.player_sees: 可轉動旋鈕；螢幕只有空白光（沒有裝膠片）。

items.name: 閱讀機桌抽屜
items.closeup_subject: the steel drawer unit under the microfilm reader desk, three drawers with recessed handles
items.player_sees: 拉開抽屜：備用燈泡和一盒保險絲、一捲絕緣膠帶。

move.movable_part: the top steel drawer front alone
move.revealed: the top drawer pulled open, seen from the front and slightly above: spare frosted light bulbs in cardboard sleeves, a small box of glass fuses and a roll of black insulating tape

items.name: 夾式工作燈
items.closeup_subject: a clip-on articulated metal work lamp with a conical shade glowing warm, spring arms
items.player_sees: 可以轉燈頭照櫃子或工作桌。

items.name: 通往走廊的門口
items.closeup_subject: an open doorway with a dark red-painted steel door ajar, the dim corridor beyond lit by red emergency light, a red caged lamp above
items.player_sees: 走廊遠處一片紅光，地上有水反光。只是回 B 的路。

items.name: 對講機
items.closeup_subject: a grey wall-mounted intercom unit with a corded handset, speaker grille and a round call button
items.player_sees: 拿起話筒：只有電流聲（保安聲音另由劇情觸發）。

move.movable_part: the intercom handset with a short length of coiled cord
move.revealed: the intercom unit with its handset removed: the empty hook, speaker grille and call button, and a pale clean patch on the wall paint where the handset usually rests

items.name: 控制台檯燈
items.closeup_subject: an articulated brass-and-steel desk lamp with a dome shade glowing warm, standing on top of a control console
items.player_sees: 可轉動燈頭照向控制台按鈕。

items.name: 控制間窗戶
items.closeup_subject: a tall steel-framed window with rain-streaked wired glass, red light from outside bleeding through, condensation
items.player_sees: 外面是紅光和雨；看不清街道。

items.name: 控制台下櫃門
items.closeup_subject: the two steel cabinet doors under the control console, louvred vents, small handles, worn paint
items.player_sees: 打開左櫃門：裡面是整束接線和一排老式保險絲座（純設備細節）。

move.movable_part: the left steel cabinet door alone
move.revealed: the cabinet interior with the left door opened: bundled old cloth-covered wiring, a row of ceramic fuse holders, dust and cobwebs

items.name: 紅色警示燈
items.closeup_subject: a red rotating warning beacon with a ribbed red glass dome on a metal base mounted on a wall, dust inside the dome
items.player_sees: 玻璃罩裡有死蟲和灰；燈在轉（氛圍）。

items.name: 路邊轎車
items.closeup_subject: a dark older 1980s sedan parked at the kerb in heavy rain, seen from the front, headlights off, rain beading on the bonnet and windscreen, fogged windows, a wet leaf caught under a wiper, dark empty interior
items.player_sees: 車內空無一人、窗戶起霧（誤導：像是剛有人坐過，但沒有證據）。

items.name: 門楣銘牌
items.closeup_subject: a large blank bronze-and-stone nameplate panel above an entrance, four bolts (one missing), rain streaks and green-free dark patina
items.player_sees: 銘牌是空白的（館名由程式疊字）；少了一顆螺絲。

items.name: 鐵柵門
items.closeup_subject: a pair of black wrought-iron gates standing half open at the bottom of stone steps between low concrete walls, rust at the hinges, rain dripping
items.player_sees: 可推動柵門（鉸鏈吱嘎）；門柱鉸鏈生鏽。

items.name: 路燈
items.closeup_subject: a tall old street lamp on a concrete pole with a curved arm and a warm sodium lamp head glowing in heavy rain, light cone full of raindrops
items.player_sees: 路燈在雨中閃了一下（可做閃爍動畫，純氛圍）。

items.name: 館正門
items.closeup_subject: heavy double entrance doors of dark wood with thick glass panels in a recessed porch, a warm ceiling light, brass push bars
items.player_sees: 門內大廳亮著一盞燈，空無一人。
